i13_db_merge_shape.instructions: How should the K22 raw DB observer plus the K23 RETURNING observer join the sealed catalogue, checker, runtime adapter, and ordinary Can surface? The I13 card mandates a catalogue.json delta with a Can helper package and typed example. Both observers are strictly in-memory doubles with no live databases, drivers, or sockets: digest-only namespace receipts, pinned identity-bound connections, one conversation per connection, lexeme-exact numbers (1.10 vs 1.1 distinct, 9007199254740993 exact), code-unit-exact text, byte-exact bytes, null kept apart from empty text/bytes/zero, preserved row order, and RETURNING payload-versus-final checks, each failure naming its engine, driver, or sql layer. K22 normatively scopes independence: the observer never imports, invokes, or inspects adapter code, values, or state; adapter claims get checked AGAINST observer facts, never the reverse. QD1 plans for Can to drive C RETURNING and verify independent final rows across PG/SQLite legs. Because runtime/ cannot import tools/, any runtime merge is a port. P14 stays blocked, so any landing is provisional and earns no execution credit.
